title.zh: 奇偶约束下语境中的读法何时粘合
title.en: When readings in context glue, for parity

statement.zh: 每个语境要求奇偶时，有不依语境的读法，恰当没有语境的选择矛盾（每个主张被计偶数次而所要求的奇偶相加为奇）；有矛盾时，不依语境之读法的混合平均至多满足 m 个语境中的 m − 1 个，按语境索引的读法满足全部 m 个。
statement.en: Where each context requires a parity, a context-free reading exists exactly where no selection of contexts contradicts (each claim counted evenly, the parities adding to odd); then mixtures of context-free readings meet at most m − 1 of the m contexts on average, readings in context all m.

laws.zh: 奇偶上的算术：两个奇偶相加（addParity）与一个量在列表上的奇偶（oddOver）；结合、交换、自消，奇偶在映射与逐项相加下的传递，及计数之界。
laws.en: Arithmetic of parity: parities added (addParity) and the parity of a quantity over a list (oddOver); association, exchange and self-cancelling, parity carried through maps and termwise addition, and the bounds on counting.

laws.zh: 奇偶约束给所计的主张与所要求的奇偶；约束相加仍是约束；一组约束矛盾，指它们相加后不计任何所列主张而要求奇；矛盾时每个赋值不满足其中奇数个。
laws.en: A parity constraint gives the claims it counts and the parity it requires; constraints added are a constraint; a list of constraints contradicts where, added, it counts no listed claim and requires odd; where they contradict, every assignment fails an odd number of them.

laws.zh: 消去：主张的相等可判定、列举不重复时，逐一消去所列主张，如在两个值上解线性方程；对每组约束，或有赋值满足每一个，或其中一组矛盾，消去后找到的矛盾带回它所来自的约束。
laws.en: Elimination: with equality of claims decided and the claims listed without repetition, the listed claims are eliminated one at a time, as in solving linear equations over two values; for every list of constraints either an assignment meets each or a selection of them contradicts, a contradiction found after an elimination carried back to the constraints it came from.

laws.zh: 奇偶系统列出主张，给每个语境它所计的主张与所要求的奇偶（ParitySystem）；赋值在语境的可能之内，恰当其所计主张之值的奇偶是所要求的；语境能显示的只取决于其内的主张；矛盾是语境的一个选择（可重复），每个主张被计偶数次而所要求的奇偶相加为奇。
laws.en: A parity system gives each context the claims it counts and the parity it requires (ParitySystem); an assignment lies within a context's possibilities where its parity on the counted claims is the required one, which depends only on the claims within the context; a contradiction is a selection of contexts, repetition allowed, counting every claim an even number of times while the required parities add up to odd.

laws.zh: 障碍：每个不依语境的赋值不满足矛盾中奇数个语境，逐个核对即找到一个，所以没有不依语境的读法在每个语境的可能之内；它至多满足矛盾的 m 个语境中的 m − 1 个，其混合（可重复计入的赋值列表）平均亦然；每个语境单独可满足时，按语境索引的读法满足全部 m 个。
laws.en: The obstruction: every context-free assignment fails an odd number of a contradiction's contexts, one found by checking each, so no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities; it meets at most m − 1 of the m contexts, and so does a mixture (assignments counted with repetition) on average; where each context can be met alone, readings indexed by context meet all m.

laws.zh: 唯一的障碍：主张的相等可判定、列举不重复时，对每个语境列表，或有不依语境的赋值满足其中每个语境，或其中某个选择矛盾；所以语境被列出时，没有不依语境的读法恰当有选择矛盾，有显示每个语境所计者、尊重其可能、在其配置粘合的世界恰当没有。
laws.en: The only obstruction: with equality of claims decided and the claims listed without repetition, for every list of contexts a context-free assignment meets each or a selection contradicts; so, the contexts listed, no context-free reading exists exactly where a selection contradicts, and a world showing what each context counts, respecting the possibilities and gluing, exists exactly where none does.

laws.zh: Specker 的三个盒子：每次打开计其两个盒子并要求奇；三次打开矛盾，每个混合平均至多满足三中之二，每次打开以自己的放置满足全部三个；Becoming.Context 的 Specker.noGlobal 由矛盾推出。
laws.en: Specker's three boxes: each opening counts its two boxes and requires odd; the three openings contradict, every mixture meets at most two of the three on average, and each opening read by its own placement meets all three; Becoming.Context's Specker.noGlobal follows from the contradiction.

laws.zh: CHSH 博弈（Clauser、Horne、Shimony、Holt，1969）：两个站各有两个设置，结果恰在两个设置都是第二个时须不同；四对设置矛盾，不依语境之结果的每个混合平均至多赢四中之三（经典之界），在语境中读出的结果赢全部四个。
laws.en: The CHSH game (Clauser, Horne, Shimony and Holt, 1969): two stations with two settings each, whose outcomes must differ exactly where both settings are the second; the four pairs of settings contradict, every mixture of context-free outcomes wins at most three of the four on average (the classical bound), and outcomes read in their pair win all four.

laws.zh: Mermin–Peres 方阵：每条线计其三个格，只有第三列要求奇；六条线矛盾，每个混合平均至多满足六中之五，在线中读出的值满足全部六条；Becoming.Context 的 Square.noGlobal 由矛盾推出。
laws.en: The Mermin–Peres square: each line counts its three cells, and only the third column requires odd; the six lines contradict, every mixture meets at most five of the six on average, and values read in their line meet all six; Becoming.Context's Square.noGlobal follows from the contradiction.

laws.zh: 环：主张 0, …, n 成环，相邻者以相等或相异相关（Gluing.Cycle.system），每个主张沿其关系被计两次；所以相异关系为奇数个时这些关系矛盾，混合平均至多满足 n + 1 个中的 n 个；为偶数个时沿环走出的赋值满足全部关系，二者互斥（Gluing.Cycle.met_iff_even）。
laws.en: A cycle: the claims 0, …, n in a cycle, neighbours related as equal or different (Gluing.Cycle.system), each claim counted twice along its relations; so with an odd number of differ relations they contradict and mixtures meet at most n of the n + 1 on average; with an even number the assignment walked along the cycle meets them all, and the two exclude each other (Gluing.Cycle.met_iff_even).

laws.zh: 沿运行：诸语境所显示者恰在读法世界在一步无语境处于该步相粘。主张不重复地列出、语境列出时，尊重可能性的读法世界在一步无语境，以及（每个主张在某个语境中）任一过程的无语境主张框架适合，都恰在没有选取矛盾处；m 个语境矛盾时，在一步无语境的读法世界至多满足其中 m − 1 个。
laws.en: Along a run, what the contexts show glues at a step exactly where the world of readings is context-free there. With claims listed once and contexts listed, a respecting world of readings is context-free at a step, and (each claim in some context) a frame of context-free claims of any process fits, exactly where no selection contradicts; where m contexts contradict, a world context-free at a step meets at most m − 1.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。主张与语境被列出；障碍与 m − 1 之界不用其他条件；唯一性（消去）以主张的相等可判定、主张列举不重复为条件；混合是可重复计入的赋值列表，以自然数计权重。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. The claims and contexts are listed; the obstruction and the m − 1 bound need nothing more; uniqueness (elimination) takes equality of claims decided and the claims listed without repetition; a mixture is a list of assignments counted with repetition, its weights natural numbers.

does_not_show.zh: 量子值：Tsirelson 之界需要实数振幅，这里不陈述（Becoming.Quantum 以整数矩阵实现方阵）。
does_not_show.en: The quantum values: Tsirelson's bound needs real amplitudes and is not stated here (Becoming.Quantum realizes the square with integer matrices).

does_not_show.zh: 超出奇偶约束的语境性（一般的可能性、概率的语境性）没有给出确切规律。
does_not_show.en: Contextuality beyond parity constraints (general possibilities, probabilistic contextuality) is given no exact law.

does_not_show.zh: 实际展开中哪些语境中的读法是这种奇偶的：这是对应。
does_not_show.en: Which readings in context of an actual unfolding are of this parity kind: that is correspondence.

does_not_show.zh: 没有矛盾不推出每个语境都单独可满足之外的东西：按语境索引的读法满足全部 m 个，需要每个语境单独可满足。
does_not_show.en: Readings indexed by context meet all m only where each context can be met alone; without a contradiction nothing more follows about them.

detail.zh: Specker 的盒子、CHSH 与 Mermin–Peres 方阵：每个都矛盾，所以没有不依语境的读法，而按语境索引的读法满足每个语境；有奇数个相异关系的环同样矛盾。
detail.en: Specker's boxes, CHSH and the Mermin–Peres square: each contradicts, so no context-free reading exists, while readings indexed by context meet every context; a cycle with an odd number of differ relations contradicts likewise.

next_delta.zh: 超出奇偶约束的语境性：一般的有限可能性的确切障碍；概率的语境性与实数振幅下的量子值（外围）；以对应定理把外围的 CorrectionRelations 环律接到这里；独立审查。
next_delta.en: Contextuality beyond parity: the exact obstruction for general finite possibilities; probabilistic contextuality and the quantum values with real amplitudes (periphery); a correspondence theorem joining the periphery's CorrectionRelations cycle law to this one; an independent review.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12 问框架所失去的是否像“wave/particle”，并同意了把值读作语境所显示者的回答；2026-10-15：“please make best of your judgement, and push the frontier of completeness”。本结果是 contextual-registration 的下一步“奇偶障碍的一般定理；概率的语境性”：对奇偶约束，“不依语境的主张是表示的承诺”成为确切的规律，这一承诺恰在一个可检查的障碍处失效，障碍给出 Bell 型的界。奇偶律是 GF(2) 上的 Gauss 消元，即线性方程组的 Fredholm 择一；全有或全无的奇偶证明出自 Mermin（1990）与 Mermin–Peres 方格，上同调的奇偶判据出自 Abramsky、Barbosa、Kishida、Lal 与 Mansfield（2015，“Contextuality, cohomology and paradox”），奇偶博弈出自 Arkhipov（2012）。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 2026-10-15 的交托采用，DELEGATED-CHOICES D33）：m − 1 与 m 之差，是语境所承载的；值是语境所显示者，一个关系。
correspondence.en: Ren asked on 12 October 2026 whether what a frame loses is like “wave/particle”, and agreed with the reply reading a value as what a context shows; on 15 October 2026: “please make best of your judgement, and push the frontier of completeness”. This result is the next step of contextual-registration, “the general parity obstruction; probabilistic contextuality”: for parity constraints, “context-free claims are a commitment of the representation” becomes an exact law, the commitment failing exactly at a checkable obstruction, which gives a Bell-type bound. The parity law is Gaussian elimination over GF(2), the Fredholm alternative for linear systems; all-versus-nothing parity proofs are Mermin's (1990) and the Mermin–Peres square's, the cohomological parity criterion is Abramsky, Barbosa, Kishida, Lal and Mansfield's (2015, “Contextuality, cohomology and paradox”), and parity games are Arkhipov's (2012). Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D33): the difference between m − 1 and m is what the context carries; a value is what a context shows, a relation.

output.en: Claims shown in context, gluing, locality and no context-free reading; the possibilities of Specker and Mermin–Peres.

input.zh: 奇偶系统的矛盾给出没有不依语境的读法与不粘合。
input.en: A parity system's contradiction gives no context-free reading and no gluing.

output.en: Totals and counts over a list; a list without repetition; checking one by one.

input.zh: 混合的平均之界；消去中逐个核对。
input.en: The mixture's average bound; checking one by one in elimination.

detail.zh: 语境所显示者总是一个世界的被索引的主张，不用粘合；这里给出奇偶约束下不依语境的读法何时存在。
detail.en: Readings in context are always one world of indexed claims, with no gluing; here, when a context-free reading exists under parity constraints.

detail.zh: 分离的描述恰在整体为矩形时给回整体；不依语境的读法恰在没有矛盾时存在：两者都是描述所失去的确切位置。
detail.en: A separated description gives back the whole exactly where it is rectangular; a context-free reading exists exactly where nothing contradicts: both locate exactly what a description loses.
